harness.note: Run AFTER the harness fixes in e772d3f3. Before those, this comparison could not have been made honestly: infrastructure failures scored as quality, and the recorded tool_calling_method reported the REQUEST rather than the outcome.

wire.gpt-5.6-terra: responses + tool_mode=native (the SHIPPED SHAPE a swap would use)
wire.why: The 5.6 default resolves prompt_based over chat-completions, which 400s on tools (see openai-5.6-tools-hazard.json). Benchmarking that would have measured a path the swap would never ship. Both sides recorded method=native, verified from the persisted metadata rather than assumed.

finding: PARITY, not superiority. Terra's median is +3.2 over gpt-5.5, but its own run-to-run spread is 7.9 — larger than the difference — and the two ranges overlap (88.1-96.0 vs 87.1-90.6). An exact permutation test on the 3v3 split gives p=0.15, so the delta is NOT distinguishable from noise at n=3.

statistics.honest_reading: Terra performs at least as well as gpt-5.5 on this suite. Claiming it is BETTER would need more runs; claiming parity is supported now.

conclusion: Parity at 40% of the price is the decision-relevant result. The swap case does not rest on Terra being better — it rests on Terra not being worse while costing 60% less.

caveats.n: 3 runs per model. Enough to show overlap; not enough to resolve a 3-point delta.
caveats.luna_long_context: gpt-5.6-luna carries 2.6x the context of the 5.5 line but scores MRCR 41.3% vs ~90% for long-context recall (Item 55, 2026-08-01). It cannot reliably recall what fits in its own window — do not buy that context expecting recall. Not benchmarked here; this suite does not exercise long context.
caveats.sol: Not benchmarked. It is the premium tier ($5/$30, SWE-Pro 64.6 vs 5.5's 59.4) and its positioning is against gpt-5.5-pro, which would need its own baseline runs.
caveats.no_sunset: /models reports shutdown_date=None for gpt-5.5 and gpt-5.5-pro (verified 2026-08-31), so this swap is cost-driven, not deadline-driven. No /doctor deprecation rows are warranted.

for_the_owner: The swap decision is yours. If the 5.6 line is configured, each model needs wire_protocol='responses' as table data — without it, tools 400.
